name: crawlx-sdk-tests
description: Official upstream Node packages driven by test_node.mjs (run by crates/crawlx-cli/tests/sdk_python.rs). The firecrawl-cli package 1.26.24 depends on the `firecrawl` SDK 4.51.0 and ships the binary its agent skills call. `overrides.zod` lifts the SDK's `zod` 3.x (every 3.x release is affected by GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, fixed in 4.6.6) to a patched 4.x.
